supervisor-sprint-check.title: Supervisor sprint check
steps: Call supervisor_report. Note the sprint, every live card, and spend against budget.
For any card at 80% or more of budget, read its failure or progress note before deciding.
Call live_read op=ls on the task sandbox paths in the report, then live_read op=read on the files that changed.
Call live_read op=team_log for the last 40 actions and look for repeated failures or loops.
Act: grant a budget top-up with a reason, delegate a scoped check, or escalate a process failure.
Finish with cards reviewed, decisions, and one next action per open issue.

failure-review.title: Failure review
steps: Identify the failed card and read its failNote end to end.
Use live_read op=read on the sandbox files the card produced or touched.
Classify the cause: bug, infra, process, or unknown. Do not guess.
A bug earns a regression-test card. Infra or process earns a note and a process change.
Record what would have caught it earlier, and name the owner.

budget-top-up.title: Budget top-up decision
steps: Call supervisor_report and find the card and its spend.
State what the spend bought so far, in concrete terms.
Decide whether the remaining work is worth another ceiling, or the card should stop.
If yes, call supervisor_grant_budget with a reason that names the remaining work.
If no, say what gets dropped and who owns the decision.

schedule-change.title: Schedule change
steps: Call schedules op=list and find the schedule by id.
Confirm the change is yours to make: you may only edit schedules you created.
For a cadence change, state the old and new interval and why.
Apply with schedules op=update, or op=delete when the watch should stop.
Report the change and the next expected run.
